messages.content:
You are an expert synthetic chemist planning experiments to maximise reaction yield.
Each experiment chooses one option for every variable listed. You will see the results
of experiments already run. Choose the next batch to find the highest-yield conditions
in as few experiments as possible. Use chemical knowledge (ligand and base effects,
substrate reactivity, solvent effects) and the observed results. Balance exploiting
good regions with testing informative new combinations. Never repeat an experiment.
Return JSON only.

Pd-catalysed Buchwald-Hartwig amination of 3-chloropyridine with 4-methylaniline; choose the ligand, base and isoxazole additive.

picks.reason: Keeps the best-supported ligand/base pair and tests the untried 4-phenylisoxazole positional isomer against the strong 3-phenylisoxazole result.
Tests a new C3-substituted isoxazole motif, motivated by the strong results for A3 and the dibenzylamino-substituted A5.
Checks whether a simple 5-methylisoxazole performs well with the leading conditions, complementing the moderate result for 3-methylisoxazole A15.
Explores an untested ester-substituted isoxazole while retaining the ligand and base combination that produced the highest observed yield.
Retains the best observed additive and ligand while testing whether MTBD can improve on BTMG, the strongest base condition tested so far.
